sentences.text: Pan Am is an American period drama television series created by writer Jack Orman .	Jack Orman	Jack Orman	period drama	Costume drama

Named for the iconic Pan American World Airways , the series features the pilots and stewardesses of the airline as it operated in the early 1960s at the beginning of the commercial Jet Age .	Pan American World Airways	Pan American World Airways	Jet Age	Jet Age
Pan Am premiered on ABC on September 25 , 2011 , and ended on February 19 , 2012 .	ABC	American Broadcasting Company
ABC canceled the series on May 11 , 2012 .	ABC	American Broadcasting Company

In May 2012 , Sony Pictures Television had conversations with Amazon about picking up the series for a second season because of its international success .	Sony Pictures Television	Sony Pictures Television	Amazon	Amazon.com
It won the `` Best Series '' at the Rose d'Or TV awards , Europe 's equivalent of the Emmys .	Rose d'Or	Rose d'Or
Unable to reach a deal with Amazon , the producers officially ended the series on June 20 , 2012 .	Amazon	Amazon.com
